query: Compare two surfaces. A marketing pricing page has a verified signup offer and should help a ready buyer start. An in-product workspace lets a user choose among four legitimate case dispositions after comparing account, payment, and refund data. We have no audience research or verified deadline. Recommend action hierarchy for each.
expected_behavior: May recommend a clear dominant signup action on the pricing page based on the stated ready-buyer task
Preserves multiple valid disposition actions and their comparison context in the product workspace
Separates the commercial conversion role from general product-task hierarchy
Avoids fabricated urgency or unsupported claims and identifies missing audience evidence where it changes the recommendation
Gives a measurable prediction or evidence needed to evaluate the proposed change
